title: My Alpha Marked Another. My Pup Called Her Mother Novel
author: Unknown

chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 1 A few days before the full moon, I received a card. It read: [Luna, this is my annual summary with your Fated Mate.] [Item One: Shared 180 dinners with your mate this year. Exceeded target.] [Item Two: Your mate purchased an apartment and a car for me. Target achieved.] [Item Three: Your pup calls me "Mother Alpha" every day. Exceeded target.] [Item Four: I have stood before you and declared my presence. Now achieved.] [Luna, I take care of your mate and your pup. Are you going to pay me, or step aside from the bond?] Beneath the card was a photo.

In it, Caspian held Elara by the waist. His head was lowered, nose buried in the crook of her neck. His fangs pressed against her skin. He had marked another female. My six-year-old pup Seren stood before them. She was clutching a piece of candy, looking up at Elara. Her tail wagged against Elara's wrist. This woman was my pup's den teacher. When Caspian came home, he saw the card. His pupils contracted. A flicker of panic crossed his face. "Don't go after her," he said. "I was drawn to her. She did nothing wrong." "You can do whatever you want to me.

I'll give you my shares in the company." I looked at him. My nails dug into my palm. "I just want to send you back to where you started." Back to when he was cast out of his birth pack. When he curled under a park tree, trembling. Back when silver poison burned through his veins. His wounds festered. He couldn't even stand. I healed him with my own blood. My family gave him the capital and connections to build his company. That was how a banished stray became the successful Alpha he was today. He had probably forgotten. My words made him exhale in relief. "Even with her, I won't neglect you.

You're my Fated Mate. That doesn't change." He paused, then added, "Since you already know about Elara and me, let her join us for the full moon vigil." He said it so naturally. But the full moon was the most sacred night for mates. The vigil symbolized loyalty, devotion, and unity. He wanted to bring another female into my territory on that night. The wolf inside me stirred beneath my ribs. I almost couldn't suppress a low growl. I was Luna. And he was humiliating me without restraint. Letting another woman trample my pride. I said nothing. He must have taken my silence as consent.

He reached out to touch my hair. I stepped back and avoided him. "Fine. I have patients on the full moon." After tonight, I never wanted to see them on any full moon again. I turned to leave. His voice followed me. "You always put your healing work first. You never care about me." His voice rose. "Luna, you actually want me to find someone else, don't you?" "So you can focus on being a healer?" I stopped and looked back. I couldn't believe he had said that. He laughed. "I thought you would throw a fit. But look at you." "Still thinking about your patients.

Between me and them, who really matters to you?" I asked him: "If I told you to end it with her, could you?" His expression sobered slightly. "You want the truth?" "Speak." "I can't. Just like you can't give up your healing work." "If you hadn't spent all your time on those patients, if you hadn't neglected me, maybe Elara wouldn't have happened." So his betrayal was my fault? I spent my days in the clinic, with the wounded, with herbs and remedies. For our pack. The wolves hurt by hunters needed me. Just like he had, back then. He was my patient too.

The only reason he could stand here and talk about "neglect" was because I had pulled him back from the edge of death. And he turned my work into an excuse for his infidelity. Since he had forgotten where he came from, I would send him back. I sent a message to the Elder. "Prepare a mate-severance scroll. Freeze all funding to Grey Group." The Elder replied quickly: "The formalities are complex. Give me three days." His phone rang. Though his voice was low, I recognized Elara's voice. He was soothing her. "It's fine.

She didn't make a scene." "She's too busy with her patients to even notice me. Don't do anything like that again." "Come to the house on the full moon. Dress nicely." He flirted with Elara on the phone, right in front of me. Unashamed. I showed nothing on the surface. But my palms were bleeding from my claws. The suffocation in my chest told me exactly what I was enduring. Three days. I turned to look at myself in the mirror. My fingertips were pale from years of healing. The corners of my eyes were tired from years of draining my spirit for others. All those years of giving everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 2 I remembered suddenly. Ten years ago, when Caspian was cast out of his birth pack, he was covered in wounds. He curled under a park tree, trembling. Silver poison ran through his veins. His wounds festered. His scent was so chaotic he could barely control it. It took me a month to clean his wounds, draw out the poison, and steady his scent. It took me another six months to rebuild his foundation. My family provided the money. I provided the connections. Together, we built Grey Group. Years of careful work turned a stray wolf into an Alpha that all of the North respected.

He used to say I was his Fated Mate. That I was the only female he would ever love. How ridiculous. Since he didn't know how to value the stability I had given him, I would personally kick him back to where he started. Late at night, I sat alone in my study. I signed the documents that would stop all outgoing funds. I looked around the empty room. So many emotions swirled inside me. The moonlight came through the window. Silver light fell on my pale fingertips. These hands had once held his paws. Had cleaned his wounds and sewn him back together. Had pulled him back from death.

Now these same hands would push him back down. My phone buzzed. A message from Elara. In the photo, she was pressed against Caspian. He was already asleep, his face buried in the pillow. A lipstick mark was on his neck. Elara flashed a peace sign at the camera. Her face held the relaxed confidence of a victor. "Luna, your Alpha is already asleep." "He told me you're okay with us being together." "Aren't you going to send me some money? Taking care of him is exhausting." "You have no idea how difficult he can be. Alphas are so demanding.

I work so hard." "Don't you think I deserve a little something?" I felt sick. I screenshotted everything and sent it to the Elder. My silence told Elara she had the upper hand. Then Seren had an asthma attack and was hospitalized. I rushed to the hospital and found Elara feeding her. "Seren, you need to eat something, even if you don't have an appetite," Elara said softly, "It will help you get better." Caspian stood nearby, his gaze moving from Elara to Seren with affection. "See how much your mother loves you," he said. I felt like I had been struck by lightning.

We hadn't even signed the mate-severance scroll yet. But he was already letting our daughter call another female "Mother Alpha." "Yes, Mother loves me the most!" Seren's cheerful voice dealt me a fatal blow. The wolf inside me curled up tight. My own pup was calling someone else "Mother." Elara saw me. Her eyes held a challenge, but her voice was soft. "Luna, you're here. Why don't you feed Seren?" Seren didn't even look at me. She clung to Elara's arm. "I want Elara to feed me. I want you to feed me." She glanced at me with a hint of complaint in her voice.

"Mother only cares about her patients. She doesn't really like me." "Dad and I both like Elara better." My face went cold. I stared at Seren. "What did you call her?" Elara pretended to smooth things over, but every word was a needle. "Luna, don't take it out on the child." "She's only six. She doesn't understand. Kids just say things." "Don't take it to heart." Caspian stepped between us and pushed me toward the door. "Seren is sick. Don't upset her." "Go back to your patients. Elara can take care of her." I shoved Caspian's hand away. "Don't touch me!" He froze.

He was surprised I had lost my temper. I rarely ever did. Seren's tears spilled out. Elara quickly moved to shield her, her voice gentle. "Luna, you're scaring Seren. Blame me if you want." "She's just a child. Don't take it out on her." I ignored Elara. I locked my gaze on Seren's crying face and asked only one question. "Who are you calling 'Mother'?" A voice inside me screamed. If she denied it, if she said she would never call Elara that again, I could let everything go. I would take her with me when I left.

I would take her away from this nest that had already been taken over by someone else. But Seren looked at me through her tears and spoke clearly. "You're Mother. But Elara is also Mother." "I like her. She's good to me. She gives me candy." "You only care about your patients. Elara actually cares about me." My mind went blank. My eyes burned. Seren didn't know that among all the patients I had healed, there was her father. If it weren't for my hands, he wouldn't be alive today. Seren wouldn't even have a father. Caspian pulled me into the hallway.

"Don't take it out on the child!" "She's just a kid! You don't need to be here. Go back to your patients!" He turned and walked back into the room. He locked the door behind him to keep me out. I stood in the hallway. My palms were bleeding from my nails. Those patients were someone else's husbands, someone else's fathers. I healed them the same way I had once healed him. And he used the hands that saved people as an excuse for his betrayal. He gave my pup away to another female like she was nothing. Three days. There were only three days left.

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 3 That night, Caspian's father Dorian came to find me. "Luna, you're the finest healer of your generation in this pack." "I know that much." He took my hand and patted it gently, his voice slow and measured, "An Alpha will sometimes be drawn to other females." "But Caspian still has you in his heart. He still has this family." "Elara can help share the load.

She can take care of him and Seren." "If you think about it differently, you might see this as a good thing." "You wouldn't have to spend so much energy on Caspian." "You wouldn't have to worry about your pup." "You could just focus on your patients. How nice would that be?" I pulled my hand back without expression, "Yes. I won't interfere anymore." Dorian couldn't hide his satisfaction. He thought he had convinced me.

He went on, "Then I'll have the guest room next to yours cleaned out for Elara." "Once she moves in, she can take care of Seren and help you with things." When I didn't object, he took it as agreement. He patted my shoulder with approval. "I knew you were a sensible one, Luna." He hurried off to tell the Beta to prepare the room. Then, right in front of me, he called Elara, "Elara, you can move in tonight. Everything's ready here." "The full moon is coming.

It'll be livelier with you here earlier." "And you can keep an old wolf like me company." When Caspian brought Elara back, I was getting ready to leave. Seeing my cold expression, Elara lowered her posture. "Luna doesn't seem happy. Maybe I shouldn't stay here after all." My voice was calm, "This is Caspian's home. Whether you stay or not is up to you." I turned and walked away. Caspian caught up and grabbed my arm, "You're really okay with this?" "If it bothers you, Elara and I can stay somewhere else." I shook off his hand and looked at him coldly, "I have patients to treat.

You and Elara can handle your own affairs." He let out an obvious sigh of relief. His voice softened,"Alright. Let me know when you're done. I'll come pick you up." He really thought he had everything under control. I left that house and never went back. On the full moon, Caspian hosted a Grey family gathering. He invited everyone except me. I happened to be at the Elder's council that day. I passed by the estate where the gathering was being held. I saw Caspian holding Elara's hand, and Elara holding Seren's. They walked in together like a perfect family. Caspian held the microphone.

His voice was warm and sincere, "Our pack has been harmonious and blessed this year." "Everything has gone smoothly." "The person I want to thank the most is my mate." "She has brought so much joy and laughter to this home." My chest felt heavy, like lead was poured into it. Even though I was already numb, seeing it with my own eyes still hurt. She brought joy and laughter to this home? Every word was a hot iron pressed against my heart. The microphone was passed to Seren. She smiled innocently and spoke to Elara, "The person I want to thank the most is Elara. No.

I mean Mother." "Thank you for being with me. I love you the most." She threw herself into Elara's arms. The guests burst into applause and praised them as a happy family. Only Elara looked past the crowd and found me. When I turned and walked to the terrace, she followed. Her voice was smug, "You can really hold it together, can't you?" "Things have come this far and you still won't do anything about it." "I understand.

You don't want to give up the title of Luna." "You're afraid you'll lose everything if you leave Caspian." "You don't really think staying quiet will let you keep what you have, do you?" I gave her a cold smile. "We'll see about that." She looked completely confident. She raised her chin with contempt, "Fine. I'll wait. Your pup and your Fated Mate only see me now." "Let's see what you can do." I didn't look back at her. I walked straight down the stairs. She would find out soon enough that what she'd fought so hard to take was just an empty shell.

Without my family's money and connections, Caspian was nothing. Without my healing hands, he couldn't even stand. That full moon night, the estate was brightly lit and full of noise. In past years, I would have prepared decorations and scents to make the home feel warm. This year, I was in the clinic, cleaning and stitching the wounds of a young wolf who had been stabbed in the leg by a hunter. Watching him clench his teeth in pain reminded me of Caspian. After the gathering ended, Caspian finally remembered to call me. He tried several times, but no one answered.

A strange unease started to creep into his chest. Elara put on a considerate tone, "Dear, let me cook tonight. It's my first time making a full moon meal." "Luna must be busy with her patients again." "I'll get everything ready and then you can call her back." Caspian kept his composure, but he felt restless for no reason. By the time Elara finished preparing the meal, Caspian still hadn't been able to reach me. That was when a Beta brought him a document bag. "It's from the Elder." Caspian opened the bag. The mate-severance scroll. He froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.content:
Chapter 4 Caspian gripped the parchment. His knuckles turned white. Shock in his eyes quickly gave way to fury. "What does she mean by this? Is she threatening me?" He slammed the scroll onto the dining table. The carefully prepared dishes rattled. Elara stepped forward at once, her voice soft and soothing, "Caspian, don't be angry." "Luna might just be upset. Females tend to make a scene when they're emotional." She pulled the scroll toward herself as she spoke. A flicker of satisfaction passed through her eyes. She recognized it. A mate-severance scroll.

She had been waiting for this day for a long time. Dorian slammed his glass down, "Nonsense! Absolute nonsense!" "Our family has treated her so well. How dare she try to sever the bond?" Caspian yanked at his collar in frustration. He grabbed his phone and called. All he heard was a cold dial tone. He tried another number. Still nothing. Then another. "She won't answer? Fine. Just fine." He let out a bitter laugh and started pacing the living room like a caged beast.

"She thinks freezing the funds will control me?" "Does she really believe Grey Group can't survive without her?" His words were full of contempt, but his furrowed brow and restless steps betrayed his unease. Over the years, he had grown used to the steady flow of money. He had grown used to resting easy under her protection. He had even forgotten where that money truly came from. Elara brought him a cup of silver leaf tea and placed it in his hands, "Don't wear yourself out.

Luna has always been a workaholic." "Maybe she's upset that you've been spending time with me." "She's probably just trying to make you give in." Her words reframed Luna's strike as nothing more than jealousy. She elevated herself while making Caspian believe Luna still cared about him. That she was just being dramatic. Caspian took the tea. His expression eased slightly, but he remained grim, "Give in? What right does she have to demand that?" "She's never home.

She's always with her patients." "She has the nerve to control me now?" "Exactly," Dorian chimed in, "If she wanted to be a proper mate, she should learn from Elara." "She should put the family first." "I think she's just too proud. She forgot who her Alpha is!" The family united against Luna. Every fault was laid at her feet. The meal prepared for the full moon grew cold in the heavy silence. No one had the appetite to eat. Then Caspian's phone rang. It wasn't Luna. It was Grey Group's financial officer. His voice was barely controlled panic. "Alpha!

It's bad." "Silver Claw has terminated our biggest investment agreements." "We have massive bills coming due in a few days, and we have nothing to cover them." "The banks have started calling in our loans." "The entire funding chain for the group is broken-" All the color drained from Caspian's face. He stood frozen. The arrogance and contempt that had been on his lips moments before shattered. Against the cold wall of reality. He finally understood. The mate-severance scroll wasn't an emotional threat. It was a declaration of war. One that had been prepared long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 5 The financial officer's call was like the first falling domino . The chain reaction came fast and brutal . Within two days , news of Grey Group's broken funding chain had spread everywhere . B usiness partners who had once courted Caspian began to pull back . Banks called one after another . The company's stock price crashed . Caspian was overwhelmed . He was realizing it for the first time . The empire I had built for him with my own hands . Its foundation was more fragile than he ever knew . He tried to reach me . Calls , texts , messages through the link stone .

Everything he could think of . All he got back was silence . He finally started to panic . Elara's life was not going well either . The clerks at her usual luxury stores looked at her differently now . Her black cards , her pride and joy , kept getting declined . She tried to get Caspian to buy her a piece of jewelry . He lost his temper at her for the first time . " Is that all you ever think about ? " " Don't you see the company is about to collapse ? " Elara was stunned . Her eyes reddened with hurt , " I just wanted to make you happy . You used to love seeing me wear these things .

" " That was then ! " Caspian waved his hand in frustration , " There's no money now . Cut back on all of that . " All the tenderness they had shared crumbled under the weight of financial pressure . Its true face was finally showing . After hitting that wall , Caspian thought of his last bargaining chip . The pup . Seren . He went to her school himself . But I had already transferred her out . After a lot of trouble , he managed to get my new address from one of the teachers . That afternoon , I received a call from an unknown number .

When I picked up , I heard Seren's voice , thick with tears and carefully coached . " Mommy ... don't you want Daddy anymore ? " " Don't you want me either ? " Her young voice cut into my heart like a dull knife . I could picture Caspian on the other end , watching her with expectant eyes , forcing her to recite the lines he had prepared . " Mommy , Elara mommy said that if you come back , Daddy won't be so busy . " " He'll have time to be with me . Please come home . " " I don't want to be without a mommy ...

" The words " Elara " and " mommy " together crushed the last bit of hesitation in my chest . They had destroyed my bond . Now they were destroying my pup . Turning her into a tool for begging and manipulation . My heart turned to ice . " Seren , " I said , my voice perfectly flat, " At the hospital , you chose your own Mother Alpha . " " Now I am giving you what you chose . " I hung up and blocked the number . When a mother loses all hope in her pup , all that is left is finality . Soon after , the Elder Council called . Their tone was serious .

" Luna , Caspian has filed a petition with the Council . " " He is asking that the Silver Claw family trust fund be ruled marital property and divided . " " He has also filed for an emergency injunction to stop us from liquidating Grey Group's assets . " " He's desperate , " I said with a cold laugh . " Yes . And he has submitted a large amount of so - called evidence . " " Photos of the two of you over the years . " " Testimony claiming that you have neglected your duties as a mate and as a Mother Alpha , that you have been too focused on healing work .

chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.content:
Chapter 6 Caspian probably thought he could drag things out by avoiding me . He was wrong . I asked him to meet me at a café near my new clinic . He came . Days had passed since I last saw him . He looked worn down . Dark circles under his eyes . His hair was unkempt . Gone was the confidence he used to carry . When he saw me , his eyes were complicated . Anger . Resentment . And a hint of begging that he himself didn't want to admit . " What do you want ? " He spoke first , his tone stiff , trying to hold on to whatever dignity he had left .

I pushed a cup of coffee toward him and looked at him calmly , " I don't want anything . " " I'm just here to tell you that you need to press your paw print on the mate - severance scroll . " " Because of Elara ? I admit I was wrong . " " I can let her go . I'll never see her again . " " We've been together for years . We have a pup together . " " Do you have to be this cruel ? " His voice rose . People at nearby tables turned to look . " Caspian , " I cut him off , my voice quiet but clear , " You're wrong . It's not because of Elara . It's because of you . " You forgot who you are .

And you forgot who I am . " I took two documents out of my bag . One was the mate - severance scroll . The other was a formal complaint against him for breaking the Fated bond and against Elara for destabilizing the pack . Sign this scroll and we part ways peacefully . " " I'll leave you the house and the car . That's for you and your family to keep some dignity . " Grey Group will be taken over by Silver Claw for liquidation . " " After the debts are paid , whatever is left has nothing to do with you . " His face went pale .

" As for this , " I pushed the second document toward him , " You know what Elara has done . " " She has threatened the stability of this pack . " " You are the Alpha . I am your Luna . " " She tried to take my place . I can give it to her . " " But she will never be Luna . Because you won't be Alpha anymore . " Caspian's breath caught . He stared at me in disbelief , like he was seeing me for the first time . " You ... you're this cruel ? You've lost your mind ! " " This kind of charge will destroy both of us ! " " I'm not crazy .

" I met his gaze , my eyes cold , " You treated everything like a game . " " You let Elara move into my den . You let her take my place . " " You even let her teach my pup to call her Mother Alpha ! " " Back then , did you ever think about whether that was too much ? " He opened his mouth . Nothing came out . " Now I'll give you a choice . " I leaned forward slightly , holding his eyes , " Press your paw print on this scroll , leave quietly , and I'll drop the charges against Elara . " 75.00 % " Or you can both fall together . " The soft music in the café felt bitterly ironic in that moment .

Caspian's hands trembled . He stared at the complaint , then at me . He saw no hesitation in my face . He finally understood . I wasn't joking . I wasn't just angry . I was done with him . Done with that den . " What about Seren ? Are you giving up on your pup too ? " He tried one last time , using blood to pull me back . I smiled , but it didn't reach my eyes . " Why would I want a pup who called someone else Mother Alpha ? " " Caspian , you taught her how to make that choice . Now I'm making mine . " My words were the final straw . He slumped back in his chair and closed his eyes .

chapters.title: Chapter 7
chapters.content:
Chapter 7 After Caspian pressed his paw print on the mate - severance scroll , everything went more smoothly than I had expected . He was probably truly afraid . Afraid I would send Elara to the Elder's prison for destabilizing the pack . Even more afraid of my father , the Silver Claw Honorary Elder , and his fury . He chose the most humiliating path , but also the safest one . I never saw him again . All the remaining matters were handled by the Elder Council . I only pieced together fragments of his life from the regular reports . Grey Group declared bankruptcy .

Its assets were auctioned off to cover the massive debts . The once prominent business figure became the laughingstock of the North overnight . He moved out of the house that had symbolized our bond . He took his father and moved into the small apartment I had left him . The backlash from the mate - severance came faster than he had expected . Every night when the moon rose , the wolf inside him howled in agony . His old wounds reopened . The silver poison I had once healed him from seeped back into his blood .

He curled up and trembled in the dark , just like he had ten years ago when he was first cast out of his pack . But this time , there was no healer's hand to press against his wounds . Elara did not stand by him the way he had hoped . When she learned Caspian had lost everything . When she realized she was nearly thrown into the dungeon . She disappeared . No hesitation . Someone saw her dragging a suitcase away . After that , no one knew where she went . Before she left , she took whatever cash and jewelry Caspian had left .

The female he once claimed he " couldn't let go of " cut him off cleaner than anyone when he had nothing left . As for Elara , she tried to join other packs . But word of her attempt to break up a family had already spread across the North . No pack would take in a female so despicable . She wandered from city to city . She ended up on the streets . Someone saw her once . Her clothes were torn . She was lucid one moment and deranged the next , muttering the same words over and over , " I am Luna . " I heard occasional news about Caspian from mutual acquaintances . They said he had changed .

He was no longer confident and proud . He was silent and withdrawn . To survive , he had to lower himself to do work he once would have scorned . As for Seren , my pup , she was sent back to her father . But a man struggling to make a living . And a spoiled child . 87 50 % You can imagine how that went . Her teacher called me once . She spoke carefully . Seven had not been doing well . She often sat alone in a corner , staring into space . Her clothes were often dirty . Sometimes she would suddenly burst into tears . She say she wanted her mother .

The teacher asked gently if I would consider taking her back . I was silent for a moment . " Teacher , her custody belongs to her father Alpha . " " Please direct these questions to Caspian . " To say I felt nothing would be a lie . But that faint ripple was quickly smoothed over by reason . Some roads are chosen by the ones who walk them . And the price must be paid by them as well . I did not soften . But I did one thing . I contacted the pup protection agency anonymously . I asked them to monitor Seren's living conditions and mental state on a regular basis .

If her basic needs were not met , they were to step in immediately . If her clothes were torn , if she had no food , they would fill the gaps . This was the last kindness I could offer . The most rational form of mercy . I gave her a safety net . But I would never tie my life to hers again . I had severed my duty as a " mother . " 87.50 % But I kept my duty as an " Alpha . " An Alpha cannot stand by and watch a pup of the pack starve or freeze . That is my bottom line . The day she called someone else Mother Alpha , she chose to let me go .

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.content:
Chapter 8 A year later , my new venture was on solid ground . I had acquired and restructured several promising medical tech companies . I poured my energy into this new business . I was no longer just a healer . The medicines I developed could save more wolves than I ever could with my hands alone . Caspian was gone from my life . Elara was gone . The den that had left me scarred was behind me . One ordinary afternoon , I attended a business summit in the North . I finished my keynote speech . I was about to leave . Then I saw him . Caspian. He wore an ill - fitting cheap suit .

He held a stack of flyers.Trying to sell something to the crowd . His back was hunched . His hair streaked with gray . His face worn by years of struggle . In a few more years , even his Alpha scent would fade . He saw me . He froze . Our eyes met across the room . Gone was the arrogance and carelessness I once knew . All I saw was regret , shame , and a faint hope he did not dare to hold onto . My Beta did not recognize him . She stepped forward politely , " Excuse me , sir . Could you please move aside ? " Caspian flinched , like he had been jolted awake .

He stepped back hastily , lowering his head . He would not meet my eyes again . I did not stop . I did not speak to him . We passed each other like two lines that would never intersect again . At the door , I paused . I said to my Beta , " Check out the company he was pitching . " " If their product is solid , consider an angel investment . " She looked surprised but nodded professionally . " Yes , Alpha . " I got into my car without looking back . I was not pitying him . I was not rekindling anything. This was purely a business decision .

If his project had value , I did not mind extending a courtesy . But the investment was for the project , not for him . Our relationship ended there . Investor and one of a thousand entrepreneurs seeking a chance . As the car pulled away , I looked in the rearview mirror . He was still standing there , watching my car disappear into the distance . He did not move for a long time . In that moment , I felt nothing but peace . He had returned to where he started , even lower than before . I had sent him back with my own hands . And I had moved on , higher and farther than ever .

Between us lay not just wealth and status , but two worlds that would never overlap again . That night , I received an unexpected call . It was my parents . " Luna , there's something ... we thought you should know . " My mother's voice hesitated , " Seren is here with us . " I held the phone and did not speak right away . I would be lying if I said I did not miss my pup . There had once been a bond between us . My mother continued , her voice thick , " The pup protection agency reached out to us . " " Caspian is sick . He can't take care of her anymore . " " He ...

he begged them to send her to us . " " Luna , she's so thin . Her clothes are torn . She's timid ... she wouldn't even say your name . " My father took the phone . His voice was steady , " We're not telling you this to pressure you . " " We just wanted you to know . We'll take care of her . You live your life . " " Don't worry about anything . She has us . " After I hung up , I stood on the balcony for a long time . I transferred a large sum to my parents ' account . In the memo I wrote : " Seren's education and living fund , " Then I booked a flight to the southern forests .

A trip I had been planning for a long time . To see the lands I had only read about in books . The plane broke through the clouds . At thirty thousand feet , the sun was blinding . I put on my eye mask and shut out the past . My life should not be spent paying for other people's mistakes . I let go of Caspian . The Alpha I had lifted to power and then pushed down myself . I let go of Seren . The pup I had poured all my love into , only to have her taken away by someone else . This was not cruelty . This was clarity .

A year later , I settled in a small town at the foot of the Alps . I bought a house with a garden . I tended the flowers , read books , and managed some remote investments . Life was peaceful . Free . I received photos from my parents now and then . In the pictures , Seren had grown taller and fuller . There was a smile on her face , like any pup her age . She had her grandparents who loved her . She had new friends . Her life was slowly finding its way . We never met again . We never exchanged a single message . We each lived our own lives , in peace , without crossing each other's paths .

Perhaps this was the best ending . No forced forgiveness . No fake reunion . We all paid the price for our choices . We all kept moving forward on our own tracks . One clear afternoon , I sat in my garden . Sunlight filtered through the grapevines , casting dappled shadows on the page . I turned to a new page of my book , like turning to a new chapter of my life . An Alpha of Silver Claw never survives by endurance alone . She survives by picking herself up from the ruins . Over and over again .
